shortDescription: NetApp ONTAP enables, disables or modifies volume efficiency

options.name: cert_filepath
options.description: path to SSL client cert file (.pem). not supported with python 2.6.

options.name: enable_compression
options.description: Specifies if compression is to be enabled.

options.name: enable_cross_volume_background_dedupe
options.description: Specifies if cross volume background deduplication is to be enabled, this can only be enabled when inline deduplication is enabled.

options.name: enable_cross_volume_inline_dedupe
options.description: Specifies if in-line cross volume inline deduplication is to be enabled, this can only be enabled when inline deduplication is enabled.

options.name: enable_data_compaction
options.description: Specifies if compaction is to be enabled.

options.name: enable_inline_compression
options.description: Specifies if in-line compression is to be enabled.

options.name: enable_inline_dedupe
options.description: Specifies if in-line deduplication is to be enabled, only supported on AFF systems or hybrid aggregates.

options.name: feature_flags
options.description: Enable or disable a new feature. This can be used to enable an experimental feature or disable a new feature that breaks backward compatibility. Supported keys and values are subject to change without notice.  Unknown keys are ignored.

options.name: force_ontap_version
options.description: Override the cluster ONTAP version when using REST. The behavior is undefined if the version does not match the target cluster. This is provided as a work-around when the cluster version cannot be read because of permission issues. See https://github.com/ansible-collections/netapp.ontap/wiki/Known-issues. This should be in the form 9.10 or 9.10.1 with each element being an integer number. When C(use_rest) is set to auto, this may force a switch to ZAPI based on the version and platform capabilit

options.name: hostname
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the ONTAP instance.

options.name: http_port
options.description: Override the default port (80 or 443) with this port

options.name: https
options.description: Enable and disable https. Ignored when using REST as only https is supported. Ignored when using SSL certificate authentication as it requires SSL.

options.name: key_filepath
options.description: path to SSL client key file.

options.name: lambda_config
options.description: Configuration parameters for AWS Lambda proxy functionality. These option and suboptions are only supported with REST.

options.name: ontapi
options.description: The ontap api version to use

options.name: password
options.description: Password for the specified user.

options.name: path
options.description: Specifies the path for the volume. Either C(path) or C(volume_name) is required. Requires ONTAP 9.9.1 or later with REST.

options.name: policy
options.description: Specifies the storage efficiency policy to use. By default, the following names are available 'auto', 'default', 'inline-only', '-'. Requires ONTAP 9.7 or later with REST.

options.name: rest_timeout
options.description: Specifies time to wait for REST API response in seconds. Only supported with REST.

options.name: schedule
options.description: Specifies the storage efficiency schedule. Only supported with ZAPI.

options.name: start_ve_build_metadata
options.description: Specifies the scanner to scan the entire and generate fingerprint database without attempting the sharing. Only supported with ZAPI.

options.name: start_ve_delete_checkpoint
options.description: Specifies the scanner to delete existing checkpoint and start the operation from the begining. Only supported with ZAPI.

options.name: start_ve_qos_policy
options.description: Specifies the QoS policy for the operation. Default is best-effort in ZAPI. Only supported with ZAPI.

options.name: start_ve_queue_operation
options.description: Specifies the operation to queue if an exisitng operation is already running on the volume and in the fingerprint verification phase. Only supported with ZAPI.

options.name: start_ve_scan_all
options.description: Specifies the scanner to scan the entire volume without applying share block optimization. Only supported with ZAPI.

options.name: start_ve_scan_old_data
options.description: Specifies the operation to scan the file system to process all the existing data. Requires ONTAP 9.11.1 or later with REST.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the specified volume efficiency should be enabled or not.

options.name: stop_ve_all_operations
options.description: Specifies that all running and queued operations to be stopped. Only supported with ZAPI.

options.name: storage_efficiency_mode
options.description: Storage efficiency mode used by volume. This parameter is only supported on AFF platforms. Requires ONTAP 9.10.1 or later.

options.name: time_out
options.description: With C(wait_for_completion) set, specifies time to wait for volume efficiency operation in seconds. Only supported with REST.

options.name: use_lambda
options.description: Specifies if AWS Lambda proxy functionality should be used to connect to the ONTAP system. Supported only with REST.

options.name: use_rest
options.description: Whether to use REST or ZAPI. always -- will always use the REST API if the module supports REST. A warning is issued if the module does not support REST. An error is issued if a module option is not supported in REST. never -- will always use ZAPI if the module supports ZAPI.  An error may be issued if a REST option is not supported in ZAPI. auto -- will try to use the REST API if the module supports REST and modules options are supported.  Reverts to ZAPI otherwise.

options.name: username
options.description: This can be a Cluster-scoped or SVM-scoped account, depending on whether a Cluster-level or SVM-level API is required. For more information, please read the documentation U(https://docs.netapp.com/us-en/ontap/authentication/create-svm-user-accounts-task.html). Two authentication methods are supported 1. Basic authentication, using username and password. 2. SSL certificate authentication, using a ssl client cert file, and optionally a private key file. To use a certificate, the certificate must h

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If set to C(no), the SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only set to C(False) used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.

options.name: volume_efficiency
options.description: Start or Stop a volume efficiency operation on a given volume path. Requires ONTAP 9.11.1 or later with REST.

options.name: volume_name
options.description: Specifies the volume name.

options.name: vserver
options.description: Specifies the vserver for the volume.

options.name: wait_for_completion
options.description: Set this parameter to 'true' for synchronous execution. For asynchronous, execution exits as soon as the request is sent, and the operation continues in the background. Only supported with REST.
